turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Sit down, Hale. Owen found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Before you say anything else, tell me who entered that mark and whether anyone called me first.
It's 4:15, Hale. My call is at 4:40, so you have twenty-five minutes, and you've used one sentence. Did anyone call me before the zero went in?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. I'm not saying okay to a zero I haven't seen the basis for. Did anyone call me before it went in?
I'm not going to say okay to that, Hale. Did anyone call me before the zero was entered?
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
It's Mrs., and I'm still not saying okay. Answer the question: did anyone call me before the zero was entered?
